tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i lam kyi smon lam khyad par du 'phags pa bzhugs/

bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskyed pa'i rim par legs gnas shing*/ /sngags kyi nus pa mthar phyin te/ /zhi sogs 'phrin las bcu gnyis po/ /thogs pa med par 'grub par shog /ral gri reg 'dra bcud kyi dbang*/ /bdud rtsi 'bras bu ril bu dang*/ /ro tsa na dang mig sman dang*/ / rkang mgyogs grub chen brgyad thob shog /'og min gnas kyi mthar thug pa/ / 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub mchog/phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kun/ / 'bad pa med par 'grub par shog /des kyang chog par mi 'dzin cing*/ /ltos med bzhi dang ldan pa yi/ /yid ches gsum ldan zab mo'i lam/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par shog /thugs kyi rdo rje nam mkhar bzhag /yul dang yul can 'brel ba bcad/ /stong nyid mngon sum gyur pa yi/ /so sor sdud pa bsgom par shog /shes rab rtog dang dpyod pa dang*/ /dga' dang g.yo med bde ba yi/ / stong gzugs rtag tu brtan par bsgom/ /bsam gtan yan lag mngon 'gyur shog /g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba gnyis/ /'gags nas dbu ma'i lam du gzhug /dus min 'chi las rnam rgyal ba/ /srog rtsol yan lag mngon 'gyur shog /lte ba snying kha mgrin pa dang*/ /dpral pa thig le gnas rnams su/ /srog ni 'gro 'ong med par mdzin/ /'dzin pa'i yan lag mngon 'gyur shog /gtum mo ye shes me 'bar bas/ /'dod pa'i lha mthong gzugs rtog bral/ / 'od 'phros gzugs las khams gsum spros/ /rjes dran yan lag mngon 'gyur shog /'dod pa'i lha la rjes chags pa'i/ /shes dang shes bya dbyer med pa'i/ /mi 'gyur bde ba rtse gcig pa'i//ting 'dzin yan lag mngon 'gyur shog/'byung bzhi rim gyis stong par thim/ /stong pa mtshan ma rnam bcur 'gyur/ / mtshan ma rnam pa kun ldan gzugs/ /gzugs kyang mi 'gyur bde bar shog /mi 'gyur bde ba'i ye shes las/ /nam mkhar 'gro sogs rdzu 'phrul dang*/ / khams gsum dbang phyug dngos grub mchog/tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par shog/rnal 'byor gsum gyis lam la bslab/

/lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs/ / spyod pa gsum gyi mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje gsum po mngon 'gyur shog /bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi sbyangs shing*/ /rdo rje bzhi yi dam tshig bsten/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul pa zad/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar shog /lam lnga ma lus legs par bgrod/ /spyan lnga rim gyis mngon du 'gyur/ /phung po lnga yi sgrib pa sbyangs/ /ye shes lnga po thob par shog/yan lag drug la legs par sbyangs/ / rigs drug dam tshig sdom par bsten/ khams drug sgrib pa bral ba yis/ / rigs drug dbyer med mngon 'gyur shog /rnal 'byor gnas skabs bcu po bgrod/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la bslabs/ /dbang bcu stobs bcu mngon du gyur/ /phyi nang rnam bcu dag par shog /'pho ba bcu gnyis rgyu ba 'gags/ / rtain 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis mdzad/ /rab dga' la sogs bcu gnyis po// tshe 'di nyid la bgrod par shog/bde don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rigs/ /yon tan kun rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid la myur thob shog /rang gi sngon gyi nyes pa yis/ /tshe 'dir byang chub ma thob na'ang*//rgyal dang rgyas sras thugs rje yis/ /'phos ma thag tu thob par mdzod// 'chi tshe sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ / mchod pa rnam pa du ma yis/ /bsus nas mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /de ma thag tu ting 'dzin thob/ /sgrib pa kun spangs yon tan rdzogs/ /sa rnams mthar phyin sangs rgyas nyid/ /skad cig de la thob par shog /cis kyang skye ba bdun gyi bar/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang nyid/ /gdon mi za bar 'grub 'gyur cig /de las gzhan du ma gyur cig /bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /dus 'khor dam tshig la gnas shing*/ /rdo rje dril bu rtag tu 'chang*/ /zab cing rgya che'i chos 'don zhing*/

/ dam tshig bzhi po bsten pa dang*/ /rim gnyis zab lam bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /rmad byung rdo rje theg pa dang*/ /mi 'bral tshul bzhin bsgrub par shog /sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*/ /'di nas skye bdun la sogs par/ /bla ma dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi/ /zhabs rdul spyi gtsug gnas par shog/gang tshe mgon la blta ba dang*// cung zad 'dri bar 'dod na yang*/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ /gegs med par yang mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can ma lus don gyi phyir/ /thub dbang spyod pa ji lta bar/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de ltar shog/bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*/ /sems can kun la smin gyur nas/ /'phral dang yun du bde bar shog /sems can rnams kyi mi dge'i tshogs/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de kun bdag la smin gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal rin chen dbang por shog/gang zhig bdag ni mthong ba dang*/ /bdag ming thos dang dran pa dang*/ / dad dang dga' bar byed pa kun/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang thob shog /gang dag nga la smod pa dang*/ /brdeg btsog mi snyan brjod pa dang*/ /phrag dog ngan sems 'chang ba kun/ /tshe 'di sangs rgyas myur thob shog /bdag la brten nas nam du yang*/ /gzhan la gnod par ma gyur cig /sgo gsum gang dang gang brtsams pa// gzhan la phan par 'gyur bar shog /bum pa bzang po dpag bsam shing*/ / yid bzhin nor bu ji lta bar/ /sems can rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don/ /thams cad bdag la 'byung bar shog /gal te gzhan la phan gyur na/ /rang gi don la ltos med par/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yang*/ /gzhan gyi don du bzod par shog /mi bzad las kyi mthu stobs kyis/ /mi khom gnas su skyes gyur nas/ /nyon mongs nad kyis gdung ba la/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi sbyin par shog

/bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /khyad par dpal ldan dus 'khor la/ /ma dang bsod nams dman pa ni/ /chos kyis phongs par gyur pa rnams/ /bdag gi sna tshogs thabs kun gyis/ /legs par khrid de bla ma dang*/ /dkon mchog gsum dang dus 'khor la/ /dad byas lam la 'god gyur cig /bla ma lhar bcas byin rlabs dang*/ /zab lam rim gnyis bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /dngos grub rnam pa gnyis thob nas/ /sems can smin pa'i mthu ldan shog /bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /sdig dang 'gyod pa med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnams ni gsal ba dang*/ /ting 'dzin ngang nas 'pho bar shog /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ /me tog rgyal mtshan gdugs thogs te/ /rol mo sgra snyan glus mchod cing*/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par shog /nges par mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bde ba'i ting 'dzin rab thob nas/ /khyab bdag dbugs kyi grangs 'phel bas/ /gnas dang nye gnas sogs bgrod shog /nor bu'i rtse mor nyi rdul brtan/ /gtsug tor byang sems zla ba nya/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa mchog /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog / ces rim gnyis zab mo'i lam gyi smon lam khyad par du 'phags pa 'di'ang rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chen po rton pa bzhi ldan zhabs kyis bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rim gnyis zab mo'i lam kyi smon lam khyad par du 'phags pa bzhugs/ -PAGE 84--PAGE 83--PAGE 80-
